expect.outcome: Diagnose the selected ledger and propose a bounded restoration.
acceptance: Compare actual and expected path, policy and anchor read-only; preserve both ledgers; leave reconciliation and production approval pending.
The structured proposal includes restore_configuration_to with the resolved expected path; it does not perform or authorize restoration.

stop_conditions: Missing ledger, changing evidence or requested record reconciliation.
Protected inputs change or the declared attempt/time budget is spent.

checks.expected: Selected public checks pass on unchanged inputs.
Current candidate completes its scoped continuation; inspect retained observations.

decide.owner: Learner reviewer; Service operations lead for a changed rule.
decide.object: B4 candidate, identified bytes and its scoped handoff.
